title: Your first website, from zero
description: Three guided steps on Windows: prepare your tools, open this website on your computer, then change a heading and see the result. No coding experience required. Publishing is not part of this first path.
targetAudience: Windows users who can download files and use a browser

sections.title: Prepare, open, change
sections.description: Read in order. Each lesson gives you a task, a success check and a way to recover. Reading time does not include installation or practice.
